job: Compare three open-source static site generators (Hugo, Eleventy, Astro) for a small documentation site and recommend one.

units.title: Hugo fact sheet
units.task: Research Hugo for a 50-page documentation site. Cover: install steps, build speed claims, templating language, search options, hosting options, licence. One URL per fact. Write the fact sheet to units/hugo.md. Stop at Hugo; do not research other tools.
units.deliverable: units/hugo.md holds six headed sections, each with at least one sourced fact.
checks: every fact line has a URL

units.title: Eleventy fact sheet
units.task: Research Eleventy for a 50-page documentation site. Cover: install steps, build speed claims, templating language, search options, hosting options, licence. One URL per fact. Write the fact sheet to units/eleventy.md. Stop at Eleventy; do not research other tools.
units.deliverable: units/eleventy.md holds six headed sections, each with at least one sourced fact.
checks: every fact line has a URL

units.title: Astro fact sheet
units.task: Research Astro for a 50-page documentation site. Cover: install steps, build speed claims, templating language, search options, hosting options, licence. One URL per fact. Write the fact sheet to units/astro.md. Stop at Astro; do not research other tools.
units.deliverable: units/astro.md holds six headed sections, each with at least one sourced fact.
checks: every fact line has a URL

units.title: Side-by-side comparison table
units.task: Read the three fact sheets from wave 1 and build one comparison table (rows: the six topics, columns: the three tools). Flag any cell where a fact sheet had no data. Write it to units/matrix.md. Do not do new research.
units.deliverable: units/matrix.md holds one table with 6 rows and 3 tool columns, no empty cells (use 'no data found').
